resources.string: Approximate correction for window attenuation. Set factors only from optical specifications or comparative measurements.
The final factor is general × channel. %1$s is neutral; 90%% transmission requires a final factor of ×%2$s. This does not replace calibration.
Nominal AS7331 channel ranges, with non-uniform spectral sensitivity. The total is the sum of the channels, not a measurement of all UV wavelengths.
The wavelengths shown are nominal AS7343 sensitivity peaks, not uniform band limits. Paired channels are averaged; HEV and totals sum the displayed channel values.
Far-red combines the 690 and 745 nm channels; NIR uses the 855 nm channel. These are channel readings, not a measurement of the entire infrared spectrum.

Offsets: allowed values %1$s–%2$s %3$s; %1$s means no subtraction. Subtract a mean background measured in darkness or under reference conditions. Applied before the factors; negative results become zero.
Update the sensor firmware to configure offsets.
Editing these offsets converts any earlier physical-channel offsets to one offset per color. Old values are retained until you make an edit.
Update the sensor firmware to configure per-channel factors.
